title: Read a COBOL payment record exactly
headline: Refused at step 'record': the Sutra layout and payment.cpy declare different records: the Sutra layout has 'pay-amount: s9(13)v9(2) comp-3', payment.cpy has 'pay-amount: s9(11)v9(2) comp-3'. Both must describe the same bytes
